definitions.explanation: The eye on the right side of the face.

examples.japanese: {右|みぎ}{目|め}に{涙|なみだ}がたまる。
examples.english: Tears well up in my right eye.

examples.japanese: ボールが{右|みぎ}{目|め}の{近|ちか}くに{当|あ}たった。
examples.english: The ball hit me near my right eye.

examples.japanese: {願|ねが}いがかなったので、だるまの{右|みぎ}{目|め}を{書|か}き{入|い}れた。
examples.english: Since my wish came true, I filled in the daruma's right eye.

notes:
Refers to the right eye from the point of view of the person whose eye it is.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右|みぎ}{目|め}をつぶる: to close/wink the right eye
- {右|みぎ}{目|め}の{視力|しりょく}: vision in the right eye

RELATED WORDS:
- {左|ひだり}{目|め}: left eye
- {両目|りょうめ}: both eyes
- {片目|かため}: one eye
